skills.description: Waltz of Forsaken DepthsPhrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. Waltz of Forsaken Depths does not consume Resonance Energy.When in the Resolving Chord state, Waltz of Forsaken Depths becomes available.Casting this skill ends the Resolving Chord state, and Phrolova enters the Maestro state for 24s.MaestroGain 120% ATK increase.Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.During this period, Phrolova plays the Volatile Notes in turn. Each Volatile Note holds for 4s.If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.- Cue - Basic Attack: Press Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast Basic Attack - Hecate. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every 2 times Hecate casts Basic Attack - Hecate, the next Basic Attack - Hecate is replaced with Enhanced Attack - Hecate.- Cue - Dodge: Press Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.- Cue - Reset: Press Jump to reset Hecate's position.- Cue - Curtain Call: Press Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast Curtain Call and end the Maestro state.When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts Basic Attack - Hecate to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to 10 times in total during Phrolova's Maestro state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect 1 times.Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro state.Ending Maestro state removes all Volatile Notes.Basic Attack - HecatePerform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).Enhanced Attack - Hecate: StringsWhen Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Strings, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG and Stagnating the targets (considered Echo Skill DMG).Enhanced Attack - Hecate: WindsWhen Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Winds, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).Enhanced Attack - Hecate: CadenzaWhen Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Cadenza, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).Curtain CallCurtain Call can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing Havoc DMG.- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the Maestro state.- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the Maestro state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, press Resonance Liberation.- When Phrolova is in the Resolving Chord state, hold Resonance Liberation.When in Resolving Chord state, casting Curtain Call removes all Volatile Notes and ends the Resolving Chord state.

skills.description: Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt PrayersBy reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, Cartethyia transforms into Fleurdelys, unlocking new moves and entering the Manifest state for 12s.Can be performed in mid-air.Entering Manifest clears all Conviction.As Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides instantly trigger 1 instance of Aero Erosion DMG and reduce the Aero Erosion stack on the target hit by 1.- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction on hit. When Conviction reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.When Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into Cartethyia. When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.When Fleurdelys has Heart of Virtue in Manifest:- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.- Fleurdelys's resistance to interruption increases. When Fleurdelys has Power of Discord in Manifest:When casting Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 and Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys or after Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides deals damage, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.Power of Discord is removed when Manifest ends. Fleurdelys will transform back to Cartethyia during quest dialogues, environmental interaction animations, or using Utilities.Fleurdelys can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, Fleurdelys can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA. Avatar - CartethyiaAs Fleurdelys, when Conviction is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2 and temporarily transform back to Cartethyia, which pauses the timer on Manifest.Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia. Avatar - FleurdelysWhen in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation as Cartethyia performs Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to Fleurdelys, which resumes the timer on Manifest.Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1.Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling SquallWhen Fleurdelys has 120 points of Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is replaced by Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall removes all Conviction, ends Manifest, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals Aero DMG to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of Aero Erosion on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.label: Rippling Waters (Outro Skill)
skills.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:0 Floral Epistle consumed:- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.Roaming TranscendentLasts for 30s.During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.Plume StepPerforming Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

skills.label: Heartward by Moon (Resonance Skill)
skills.description: Resonance Skill - Answering FormWhile in Answering Form, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG.After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4.Can be cast in mid-air.If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the Moon Fox. - While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin gains Dustless Tread. With Dustless Tread, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. Dustless Tread is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the Moon Fox form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.- Taking damage, failing to perform a Dodge with directional input while on the ground, or Dodging in mid-air will end the Moon Fox form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing Resonance Skill also ends the Moon Fox form. Press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4, which also ends the Moon Fox form.- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.- Resonance Liberation is disabled when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.Resonance Skill - Illumining FormWhile in Illumining Form and Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.label: Nexus Alight (Resonance Liberation)
skills.description: FormshiftCasting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.Pillars Across HeavenAfter casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.EdictCasting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG. - Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.Heart ManifestIncreases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.Invoked Form: AnsweringHsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.Invoked Form: IlluminingHsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

skills.label: Glance on a Whim (Intro Skill)
skills.description: Intro Skill - Answering FormThis skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3 (when in Resonance Mode - Unison) or Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4 (when in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold UnisonThis skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.Intro Skill - Illumining FormThis skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold UnisonThis skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.

skills.label: Forms Turn, Heart Abides (Forte Circuit)
skills.description: Forms Born of HeartWhile in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm WandererWhile in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All HorizonsWhile in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.Can be cast in mid-air.Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars AlignedWhile in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.Mechanism DominionThe Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.Resonance Mode - UnisonWhile in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.Resonance Mode - Electro FlareWhile in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stack(s) of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 time(s). Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stack(s) of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stack(s) of Electro Flare on the target hit.UnisonWhile Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.Unison ResponseWhile Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stack(s) of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.Hsin can only grant up to 1 stack(s) of Unison Boon in this way.Unison BoonOnly the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.Answering HeartCan hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.Illumining HeartCan hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

inherentSkills.name: Tides of Succession
inherentSkills.description: While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, Her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

inherentSkills.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
inherentSkills.description: While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare on a target, every 1 stack of Electro Flare inflicted grants Hisn 1 stack of Thunderglow, stacking up to 10 times.While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, She also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.

resonanceChain.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
resonanceChain.description: Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, stacking up to 2 times. Switching to Answering Form clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of Radiance Ward can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.While in Resonance Mode - Unison:The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison are increased by 15%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison by 10%, up to a total of 4 stacks.While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:When Hsin enters combat, if Heart of Thunder is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 12s.The DMG Multiplier of the Electro Flare DMG triggered by Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon is increased to 42% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).

resonanceChain.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
resonanceChain.description: The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector are increased by 60%.The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons are increased by 60%.When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain Resolution of Wishes and Law of Heaven, and restore 100 additional points of Answering Heart. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.

resonanceChain.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
resonanceChain.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 70%.While in Resonance Mode - Unison:The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 20%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, up to a total of 4 stacks.While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:When the last stage of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven hits a target inflicted with Electro Flare, it triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current Electro Flare stacks on the target.

resonanceChain.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
resonanceChain.description: All Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:- Inflict Electro Flare or Electro Rage on a target.- Gain Unison while not having the effect.- Trigger Unison Response.

resonanceChain.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
resonanceChain.description: While in Illumining Form, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute.

resonanceChain.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
resonanceChain.description: Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.While in Resonance Mode - Unison:The maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team additionally gain 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:While in combat, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.
